topics.title: Domain-driven design, clean code, test-driven development
topics.text: domain-driven design (ubiquitous language, bounded contexts as crates, entities, value objects and aggregates, repository traits at the domain edge, IO-free domain, anti-corruption layers at integrations), clean code (small intention-revealing functions, single responsibility, no duplication or dead code, `Result` instead of `unwrap` in domain code), and test-driven development (write a failing test first, then the minimum code to pass, then refactor; no change without a test). Simplicity (ponytail) applies inside these rules, never against them.

topics.title: Rust design patterns (summary of the book)
topics.rule: Obey these patterns. Reviewers reject violations.

topics.title: SDK common mistakes and principles
